status: built 2026-11-02 (see derived/packs/SIZES.md); rules changed the same day for the owner decisions in OWNER-DECISIONS.md, to be applied at the next rebuild of Small and Medium
measured: 2026-11-02 against a catalog snapshot of 14,073 records (sha256 of catalog.json begins 9e6ce42e2e686798). The library is live; a build must re-measure.

layout.usage: LASTBOOK_DATA or --data points at the pack folder. No app change is needed to open a size.

tree.pack.json: name, size, map, built, counts, add-ons merged
tree.pack-manifest.tsv: path, bytes, sha256 for every file
tree.library-data/catalog.json: rewritten, membership and field allow-list applied
tree.library-data/search.sqlite: rebuilt from existing rows, same FTS5 schema
tree.library-data/documents/: catalog paths and the Sources page
tree.library-data/videos-external/: a real folder here, never a link

layout.file_copy_rule: APFS clone (cp -c) for unchanged files. Never a hard link: engine/library.py file_ok refuses st_nlink>1. Never a symlink.

flagged_28.rule: verdicts.json dangerous==true; checked identical to safety-triage.csv group=flagged-dangerous; all 28 are in the catalog; out of every size

video_filters.kept: verdict in {keep, reference}, not flagged, id not in video-exclusions.json. 'dropped' is verdict in {slop, spam, unverified}.
video_filters.no_verdict: out of every size until the redone review (open decision D2)

small.documents: catalog records named by a shipped guide (doc field) with kind pdf, html or pptx, minus known_gap_documents; plus with_chapters
small.videos: Guide videos plus the reviewed essential-video inclusion list, minus the Small-only exclusion list.

medium.documents: all records of kind pdf, html, pptx minus known_gap_documents and firearms_documents; transcript records with no video_path
medium.videos: kept, verdict keep only, category in medium_topic_categories, not corporals, not firearms_hunting; plus the guide videos

all.documents: all records of kind pdf, html, pptx minus known_gap_documents; transcript records with no video_path

addons.shape: same layout as a size, with its own catalog.json, search.sqlite and summary.json, and no map set
addons.merge: packaging/pack_merge.py with the app closed: copy files, union catalog.json by id, ATTACH the add-on search.sqlite and INSERT its rows, recompute summary.json, note it in pack.json. Removal deletes those ids and files.

every_video_brings: thumbnail_path via a reduced metadata record

metadata_records.search_rows: none; find() and assistant.py already skip kind metadata

paths_excluded.signed_permissions: never; only the public list on the Sources page

strip.applies_to: every .html and .htm under pages, courses, documents; clones are never edited in place, the output is a new file
strip.parser: stdlib html.parser, streaming; tags left unchanged are emitted from their original text, so entities and spacing survive
strip.first: saved_pages._BLANK_ROW removal on any page over saved_pages.MAX_PAGE
remove_with_content: iframe with a remote or absent src
remove_tag: link unless rel=stylesheet with a local href
meta http-equiv in refresh, set-cookie, content-security-policy, x-ua-compatible
img with no usable source left: no src or srcset, or only remote or absent ones
remove_attribute: href, xlink:href on anything except a and area, when remote
src, poster, background, data, lowsrc, dynsrc, longdesc, cite when remote
srcset and imagesrcset entries that are remote
action, formaction, ping, manifest, codebase, classid, archive, profile
data-* whose value is a remote URL
href on a and area with any scheme or //: web, javascript:, data:, file, mailto and the rest
strip.css: in style elements and style attributes: remove @import and replace url(remote) with none
keep: data-toggle, data-target, class and every other attribute that engine/saved_pages.py matches
strip.remote_means: any URL with a scheme, or beginning //
strip.serve_time: engine/saved_pages.py stays as it is; the scan runs saved_pages.rewrite on each stripped page and rescans the result
strip.not_in_the_pack: after the pack is known: a local link to a file it does not hold becomes plain text; a source or srcset entry naming such a file goes, and an img left with no source goes
strip.unwrap: an a or area that loses its href, or names a file the pack does not hold, goes and its words stay as plain text; an a with an id or name keeps the bare tag, since a link within the page may point at it

state.rule: base plus rows inside the state box; box = ZCTA centroids in profiles.sqlite, plus or minus 0.15 degrees
state.places.sqlite: base rows; plus OpenStreetMap rows in box

country.rule: base plus rows inside the country box; box = bounding box of the Geofabrik OpenStreetMap extract polygon for the country (packaging/europe-countries.json), plus or minus 0.15 degrees; region code eu-<iso>, so a country never takes a state's code
country.places.sqlite: base rows; plus OpenStreetMap rows in box
country.note: Same cutting rules as a state; what a country set holds is bounded by the source layers' own coverage. Publishing is opt-in (packaging/country-publication.json) and packaging/state_maps.py refuses a country whose built set has no detailed roads, help or water points, terrain, buildings, crops or OpenStreetMap place names inside its box. Address indexes stay US-only: their source (Overture addresses) is split by US state.

all_sets.national-status.json: {state: complete, stage: ready, features: N} and nothing else
all_sets.socal-cells.json: [] unless map.sqlite holds SoCal; socal_cells() writes this file without a guard if it is missing
all_sets.journal_mode: DELETE on the clone; water.sqlite has an unmerged WAL, so clone it with -wal and -shm and checkpoint the clone

scrub.national.sqlite: UPDATE meta so status carries no source or database path
scrub.terrain.sqlite: meta.source reduced to the publisher name

search_index.method: CREATE the table in a new file; INSERT rows from the snapshot where doc_id is in the pack and kind is not metadata; apply any collection rename; INSERT INTO pages(pages) VALUES('optimize'); VACUUM; integrity-check

vectors.why: retrieval.py needs the bge-small ONNX model to embed the question, and no model goes in a pack; without it the vectors are never loaded
vectors.if_owner_reverses: active chunks are 407,741 of 2,396,858 rows, so about 0.31 GB of vectors in All; subset, no re-embedding

sources_page.content: each owner in this pack, from its catalog records: what is included, source site (website/data/credits.json), that owner's terms from the public list when written, removal contact hello@lastbook.org; map sources; the not-clinically-reviewed label

scan.terms_file: derived/packs/private-terms.txt, outside the repo; never in the tool. Seed from derived/app-build/scan-terms.txt
scan.accept_file: derived/packs/scan-accepted.tsv: path, reason, who accepted. Empty until the owner decides
scan.all_files: fail on a name in paths_excluded; a term in a path; a symlink; st_nlink>1; an extension outside its folder's allow-list; a name engine/library.py segments_ok(windows=True) refuses; a path over 200 characters
scan.html: by parser, not regex: fail on any item that strip removes, on the raw page and on the output of saved_pages.rewrite; fail on a term; fail on UTF-16 or an unparseable page
scan.svg: fail on script, on*, foreignObject, an external href, a term
scan.our_json: catalog.json, summary.json, pack.json, national-status.json: fail on any term, /Users/, /home/, /Volumes/, C:\Users, LAN address, or field outside the allow-list; for catalog also check membership (none flagged, dropped, no-verdict; no Corporals or firearms in Small or Medium; known gap absent; every named path exists)
scan.search_sqlite: raw byte scan for terms; doc_id set equals pack catalog ids with text; no metadata rows; freelist 0; integrity-check
scan.map_sqlite: journal DELETE, no -wal or -shm; fail on a term in sqlite_master, meta, done, source, origin; a term in a place or feature name is listed, not failed; blobs not scanned
scan.pdf: search raw bytes and inflated /ObjStm streams for /JavaScript /Launch /SubmitForm /ImportData /GoToE /RichMedia, and for /JS /XFA only inside a parsed object since 3-byte and 4-byte markers match by chance in compressed data; fail unless accepted; /EmbeddedFile fails too, since an attachment can hold anything; /OpenAction /GoToR /URI are listed, not failed; fail on a private term in the file; a generic /Users/ is not a failure, since 58 public PDFs hold other people's paths
scan.video: sha256 equals catalog; moov atom: fail on a term in tags; streams not scanned
scan.images: first 64 KB: fail on a term
scan.zim: sha256 equals catalog; fail unless the filename is in accepted; contents not rewritten or scanned
scan.user_path_pattern_note: case-sensitive and only in our own files. Case-insensitive matching hit 14 false alarms in third-party text in this library, such as cdc.gov/mmwr/volumes/.

added_in_fix_round.html.web_anchor: a or area to the web; fails on every page, with no excuse (decision A)
added_in_fix_round.html.non_web_link: a or area with file, ftp, mailto or any other scheme
added_in_fix_round.page.dead_reference: a, area, img or source naming a local file not in the pack
added_in_fix_round.pdf.embeddedfile: attachment inside a PDF; excused by path
added_in_fix_round.catalog.transcript_with_no_video: the app points a player at it
added_in_fix_round.term.household: a household or working word from ship_edits.json forbidden; in our own fields always fails, in third-party text accepted by path
added_in_fix_round.html.image_with_no_source: img with no src or srcset: an empty box
added_in_fix_round.catalog.course_record: a record not in the snapshot passes only as a course record of the shape course_records gives

snapshot.rule: never create or take a lock; read clones only
steps: lsof index.lock shows no holder and no *.building.sqlite exists
repeat step 1 and 2; retry on any change
validate clones: JSON parses; PRAGMA integrity_check; every doc_id in FTS is in the catalog
derive the frozen file list from the clone
for each file: exists, size equals catalog bytes (or remote-videos.json), not modified in the last 10 minutes, sha256 at copy

proposed_edits_not_made.E1_server_py: /api/library adds zims (catalog kind zim); resolve_item returns nothing for a zim item whose file is absent, and topics_resolved drops it
proposed_edits_not_made.E2_web_app_js: filter the hard-coded ZIMS list by s.zims when present, and say the count in the Encyclopedias lead
proposed_edits_not_made.E3_web_app_js: hide the Still arriving card when there is no download status
proposed_edits_not_made.E4_app_main: Lastbook --add-pack <folder> calling pack_merge; first run standalone from packaging/
proposed_edits_not_made.effect_on_8890: none until restart, and none after it: all four ZIMs exist and status exists
proposed_edits_not_made.note: E1 to E3 were made in the 2 Nov app round

disk.note: 100.5 GB of All's videos are on the Studios and 2.4 GB on the external drive; these cannot be clones

pdf_one_offs.measured: raw bytes of 4,619 PDFs; object streams not inflated, so a floor
pdf_one_offs.accepted: every other PDF with built-in actions or attachments in Small or Medium, by name in scan-accepted.tsv (owner, OWNER-DECISIONS.md 2026-11-02); the app keeps its block

leave_out_one_file_why: the 23 pages titled 404: Page Not Found are saved error pages, not content: one was a record (5e759b142997bef3), the other 22 shipped only as files in the pages tree; owner 2026-11-02: take them out

catalog_rules_in_a_pack.transcript_with_no_video: kind becomes html, so the app shows it as text
catalog_rules_in_a_pack.see_source: publisher See source becomes the web host of source_url

id_renames: packaging/ship_edits.json id_prefixes: the same map the shipped guides use, so a guide card and its record carry one ID. text/<id>.txt is renamed with its record.
household_renames: renames and note edits that name the home area are kept in a local copy of this file, never in the repository
household_words: packaging/ship_edits.json forbidden, read by scan_pack.py as term.household: catalog, search, page and text files, file names. Third-party text that names the place is accepted by path in scan-accepted.tsv.

decided.renames: collection_renames, path_renames, id_renames and note_edits always apply

leave_out_id_prefixes.land-: one-off 14: 30 pages about land data no pack holds; their 3 guide cards are out of the shipped guides

course_records.rule: one html record per folder courses/<slug>/ that has an index.html and snapshot records, in every size that holds courses (Medium, All)
course_records.fields: title, publisher, collection, category, course, level, source_url, license_url and retrieved_at: the value most of that course's snapshot records carry; title is their shared title before the first dash
course_records.search: one row, its title as the body; nothing is extracted
